what: Lane MT's check was 'the rows shrink in the next census, quoted before and after'. The censuses from g043439 to g050933 stopped at a panic and held no builder CLASS rows. g051231 and g051728 ran, but on a tempo_build binary built before batch 2 was admitted: they still print 'a structural match of an ADT constant is not built', a message that is no longer in the tree. g052251 stopped at a static ('an unsizing coercion other than an array to a slice'). So batches 2 and 3 have no after-count yet.
cost: about 15 minutes of reading census files to work out which tree each one ran on
cause: a census header names the tree it measured but not which runner admissions that tree holds, and a census that stops early writes no builder section at all
whys: the census stops at the first panic or refused static instead of reporting the builder classes it had reached
class: a check that depends on a later measurement, with no way to tell whether the measurement contains the change
prevention: wanted: the census header lists the last admitted runner ref in its tree, and a census that stops early still writes the builder classes it reached
annoyance: the typeck fixture's Bb keeps `pats` private and has no `_` or `x @ p` builder (added bind_sub and wild)
workaround: for each class, compare the census text with the refusal strings in the tree to see whether the binary predates the fix
